##### Project general facts

Talay and Talay Beach at Marsa Al Saadiyat is the first residential address within a waterfront destination, made up of two gated communities of standalone villas designed around family life, greenery and a strong sense of belonging. Named after the birds that trace the shoreline, the community honours Emirati heritage through areesh-inspired boundary walls and screens reinterpreted by Emirati designer Abdalla Almulla. Each villa rises from a ground floor to a first floor, offering four-, five- and six-bedroom homes with private gardens.

A green corridor and a traditional aflaj water feature run through the community, naturally cooling the air and connecting the homes with shared spaces. Residents enjoy a community pool and kids' pool, a gym with parkland views, padel courts, jogging tracks and cycling loops. A kids' discovery garden inspired by dhows and pearl diving, an outdoor majlis pavilion, picnic areas, a pet park, electric vehicle charging, a landmark fountain, a kitchen garden and exclusive beach access complete the offer.

Interiors are offered in light and dark finish schemes, each with carefully selected materials, textures and tones. Homes feature a show kitchen with tinted glass cabinets and engineered stone countertops alongside a separate daily kitchen and pantry, wood veneer doors and joinery, leathered marble stairs and brushed bronze fittings. Integrated smart-home systems manage lighting, climate and security, and energy-efficient systems run quietly in the background. Homes are delivered unfurnished, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Saadiyat Island is Abu Dhabi's cultural and natural landmark, home to one of the world's top-ranked beaches, world-class golf courses, leading schools and globally renowned museums. The surrounding waterfront destination stretches along an extensive coastline with beach clubs, cafes and the largest marina in Abu Dhabi, alongside generous green open spaces and views towards the Al Reem Island skyline by day and night.

Louvre Abu Dhabi, Zayed National Museum, Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, the Abrahamic Family House, Manarat Al Saadiyat, Berklee Abu Dhabi and NYU Abu Dhabi are close by, and several private schools and nurseries sit within walking distance. Abu Dhabi Global Market lies just across the water, while Yas Island, Zayed International Airport, Fahid Island and the city centre are within easy reach by car.

Saadiyat Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious addresses in the UAE. The surrounding destination marks the final chapter of waterfront living on the island, making gated standalone villas close to the beach and the cultural district especially scarce. Strong demand from high-net-worth families supports long-term value and resilient resale prospects for owners.
